q: Which pump lifts water from an underground cistern to an overhead tank?
n: Transfer pumps fill the elevated tank.

q: Which pump keeps the sprinkler piping pressurized?
n: The jockey pump makes up small leaks.

q: Which pump raises water pressure when supply pressure is too low?
n: Booster pumps add pressure.

q: Which pump uses a spinning impeller to move and pressurize water?
n: Centrifugal force drives the flow.

q: Which pump is installed in an elevator pit?
n: Sump pumps clear water from the pit.

q: Which sprinkler system keeps pressurized air or nitrogen in the pipes until it activates?
n: Water enters only when a head opens.

q: Which system floods an area with water at once through open heads?
n: All deluge heads discharge together.

q: Which system suits places where accidental discharge must be avoided, like museums?
n: Pre-action needs detection before water enters.

q: Which sprinkler system is the most reliable and most widely installed?
n: Wet systems are simple and fast.

q: Which equipment controls or suppresses fire over a wide area?
n: Sprinklers cover whole floors.

q: Which standpipe is for firefighters' use only?
n: Dry standpipes are charged by the fire department.

q: What best justifies escalators over elevators?
o: Continuous heavy foot traffic between nearby levels
n: Escalators move crowds continuously.

q: What is a small lift that carries objects, not people?
n: Dumbwaiters move food or documents.

q: Which cable feeds power to the elevator car and moves with it?
n: The traveling cable hangs from the car.

q: What pipe supplies each floor with water for firefighting?
n: Standpipes feed hose valves on each floor.

q: What is a Siamese (fire department) connection for?
o: Letting fire trucks pump water into the standpipe or sprinkler system
n: The FDC lets the fire service boost the system.

q: Which system is set off by heat and discharges only at the heads that open?
n: In a wet system water is already at each head.

q: Which pump removes water from the lowest part of a building?
n: Sump pumps drain pits and basements.

q: Which pump keeps adequate pressure on the upper floors of a multi-story building?
n: Boosters make up static head losses.

q: Which of these does NOT make elevators?
o: None of the above — all three do
n: All three build elevators.

q: Which elevator brand is from Finland?
n: KONE is Finnish.

q: Which is one of the oldest elevator makers, founded in the United States?
n: Elisha Otis demonstrated the safety brake in 1854.

q: Which German company makes elevators and escalators worldwide?
n: Schindler is Swiss and KONE Finnish.

q: Which of these makes elevators and escalators?
n: KONE is a lift maker.

q: Which part opens and closes elevator doors automatically?
n: The operator is mounted on the car top.

q: Which is NOT a fire protection device?
n: A helmet is personal protective gear.

q: What device senses smoke and triggers an alarm?
n: Smoke detectors sense particles.

q: Which part discharges water automatically when it senses heat?
n: A fusible link or glass bulb opens the head.

q: Which equipment is used to put out small fires by hand?
n: Portable extinguishers are for incipient fires.
